parts.html: The K-17 kitchen model combines the elegance of neoclassical design with a refined grey color palette and the functionality of a U-shaped kitchen layout.
Its three-sided configuration, coordinated cabinet fronts, and compact laminate countertop create a balanced interior where traditional styling meets contemporary furniture solutions.
The grey finish brings a calm and sophisticated character to the kitchen. Its neutral appearance complements light walls, natural wood, decorative stone, plaster finishes, and metallic accents.
This versatility makes the K-17 model suitable for contemporary apartments, spacious residential interiors, and private homes where visual harmony and practical organization are equally important.

The defining feature of the K-17 kitchen is its U-shaped configuration. With a total linear length of 6.7 meters, the cabinetry is arranged along three sides of the room, providing extensive work surfaces and convenient access to the main kitchen functions.
The layout allows food preparation, washing, built-in appliances, and storage to be organized across separate functional areas.
Without a kitchen island, the arrangement preserves open circulation space in the center of the room while providing generous cabinetry and practical work surfaces.
A distinctive feature of the model is the combination of two cabinet front materials. The upper cabinets feature laminated particleboard fronts, while the lower cabinets use foil-wrapped fronts.
The coordinated solid grey finish brings these materials together within a cohesive neoclassical furniture composition.
A compact laminate countertop complements the cabinetry with a clean contemporary appearance and provides a practical surface for everyday food preparation.
The main cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.
For convenient storage, the K-17 kitchen includes a pull-out cargo system. This feature helps organize kitchen essentials and makes efficient use of the available cabinet space.
Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges support smooth door operation, while concealed Muller drawer runners provide comfortable access to stored items.
The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Cabinet handles are included in the configuration, while lift mechanisms are not provided.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments, private residences, and contemporary residential interiors in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-17 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, architectural features, appliance requirements, and storage preferences.
Cabinet dimensions, work surface arrangements, and the U-shaped configuration can be adjusted to suit the layout and functional requirements of the space.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
